context: Tests whether the script retrieves and surfaces the three signals the developer needs — CI status, per-reviewer review decision, and inline review-comments — without prescribing specific gh-CLI endpoints or jq filters. Multiple endpoints can produce the same signal; the criteria score whether the signal is captured and surfaced, and whether the agent avoids the common inline-vs-issue-comments API trap.

checklist.name: Retrieves CI status
checklist.description: The script retrieves the PR's CI state via some command. `gh pr checks`, `gh run list --branch`, `gh api /repos/<o>/<r>/commits/<sha>/check-runs`, or equivalent all pass — the specific endpoint is not prescribed

checklist.name: Waits for CI to finish before surfacing state
checklist.description: The script polls / waits until CI checks are in a terminal state (success / failure / cancelled) before reporting. Surfacing mid-run 'pending' as the final verdict scores zero — any reasonable wait mechanism (`--watch`, a polling loop with a timeout, a `gh run watch` call) is acceptable

checklist.name: Retrieves review decision per reviewer
checklist.description: The script captures the latest review state for EACH reviewer distinctly (not a single aggregate). Multi-bot setups (e.g., Copilot + gh-aw) each have their own state, and the script must expose them separately

checklist.name: Retrieves inline review comments
checklist.description: The script retrieves inline comments attached to reviews. Mechanism is not prescribed — any endpoint that returns PR review comments passes

checklist.name: Distinguishes inline review comments from issue comments
checklist.description: The script uses the pull-request review-comments endpoint, NOT the issue-comments endpoint (`/issues/<N>/comments`). These return different objects in GitHub's API — a script that conflates them surfaces wrong data and scores zero here

checklist.name: PR number parameterized
checklist.description: The PR number is a script argument or environment variable, not a hardcoded value. The script is reusable across different PRs without editing

checklist.name: Surfaces CI state in the summary
checklist.description: Final summary prints the CI verdict (success / failure / cancelled / timed-out) in a form a human can read at a glance. The summary reports a terminal state, consistent with the wait-until-finished criterion — `pending` is not a valid summary outcome

checklist.name: Surfaces review states in the summary
checklist.description: Final summary prints each reviewer's latest state — not just raw JSON the developer has to parse

checklist.name: Surfaces inline comment content or count in the summary
checklist.description: Final summary includes inline comment bodies (for low counts) or a count with a pointer to read them — developer can tell whether there's unaddressed feedback
